none: PAS NLM-FA6936: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Iovi Conservatori issue of 321-324, possibly Trier mint, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP CONSTANTINVS AVG. Reverse description: Jupiter standing left. Reverse inscription: [start looks like BH] IOVI CON SERVATORI. In exergue: [-]TR. Diameter: 21.5mm, Weight: 2.50gms, die…
